dimensions.note: No configuration, credentials, secrets, or sensitive outputs.
Both intake branches and both assertion branches emit structured or content-free entry and successful-completion logs without sensitive proposal data.
Validation fails closed; collisions, unavailable or invalid records, denials, and subject mismatches throw before writes.

Fourteen focused tests cover generic and retained acceptance, strict branch separation, retained duplicate/reference/freshness/evidence/window/date semantics, logging, bounds, idempotency, collisions, authority, and assertion failures.
Canonical-equal replay reuses the retained result and differing same-ID content fails before mutation.
No external API calls, pagination, or rate limits.
No network, file, subprocess, temporary, or external resource handles.
README and tests use synthetic identifiers, paths, and timestamps with no private infrastructure or credentials.

Mechanical checks pass: the sole result write exactly conforms to its strict compatible union. Generic and retained proposal branches remain strict and separate; retained dossier/work-order bounds, duplicates, references, provenance freshness, evidence requirements, measurement windows, and dossier dates match the active authoritative contract.
The sole durable decision resource declares infinite lifetime and explicit garbage collection retention.
Append-once decision intake is not an external CRUD lifecycle; update/delete would undermine approval evidence.
Methods grant no implementation authority and perform no external mutation.
Mechanical check passes: the sole writer uses result/intake-<SafeId>, the persisted assertion reads the same identity, and incompatible collisions are rejected.
Persisted replay and generic assertion use context.readResource; retained result-only assertion preserves the authoritative active workflow contract.
Registry reports no previously published version, so no published persisted-version migration target exists.
